Results.Title: Newbuild Contracting Running Hot
Results.Synopsis: Newbuild contracting has been exceptionally strong across 2026 so far, with volumes running at a similar pace to the record 2007 level, albeit remaining well below when expressed relative to the size of the fleet. Here we put this latest wave of newbuilding activity into context, and analyse trends in the investor base, with some owner countries markedly stepping up investment.

Results.Title: A Bumper Year For Grain Trade (So Far)
Results.Synopsis: Grain trade has delivered a bountiful harvest for dry bulk shipping so far in 2026, led by record shipments from major exporters in the Americas. Strong volumes on long-haul routes into Asia have supported tonne-mile demand growth and provided a tailwind for mid-sized bulkers in particular. However, there are a range of complexities to watch ahead, from geopolitics to climate patterns…

Results.Title: Russian Oil Trade: Attacks Reshape Export Mix
Results.Synopsis: Attacks on Russian oil infrastructure have remained highly in focus in 2026 with the scope of these attacks broadening from refineries to export terminals and vessels in the Black Sea in recent weeks. These incidents are generating a range of impacts on seaborne Russian oil flows, alongside implications for tanker demand and oil markets more broadly.

Results.Title: Canadian LNG: Strong Growth, Increased Momentum
Results.Synopsis: Since the start up of the LNG Canada liquefaction terminal in July 2025, Canadian exports have grown swiftly and are already accounting for a material source of LNG carrier demand in the Pacific Basin. Furthermore, amid a range of supportive factors, LNG exports from Canada are set to see further strong growth over the coming years.

In this Analysis we review latest trends and plans to boost energy security by developing “bypass” options.

Results.Title: US And Chinese Port Fees: Taking Stock...
